name: flow/settings-toggle-flow
title: Settings toggle flow
title_vi: Thẻ cài đặt có công tắc
desc_vi: Thẻ cài đặt trồi lên, từng dòng tùy chọn trượt vào, các công tắc đang bật nảy nhẹ vào vị trí.
params_vi: rows: danh sách dòng { title, sub, on } · ink, muted, border, surface, rowBg, off, knob: màu · scale: độ phóng to (1.2)
notes: Layout, colours, radii, spacing and the three staggered tweens are as in the source (card y 24 + opacity, 0.34 s power2.out at 0.28 s; rows x -18 + opacity, 0.28 s power2.out, stagger 0.08 at 0.55 s; switches that are on scale 0.92 -> 1, 0.28 s back.out(1.8), stagger 0.08 at 0.88 s). Where the source demo differs from the snippet its value is used (sub line weight 500 instead of 760); the demo's 1.2x enlargement is the param `scale` (a wrapper with transform: scale that is never tweened). Font: the film's font instead of Inter. The switch knob was a ::after pseudo-element with transform: translateX(22px) for the on state; it is a real child element here placed at left 26 px (on) or 4 px (off), same pixels. The switches are div elements instead of i. Rows are a param (array of { title, sub, on }, any number of rows; source: three fixed rows) with Vietnamese defaults (source: English).
